draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Tirur! Its railway station, built in 1861, is the oldest in Kerala. Tirur is also the birthplace of Thunchath Ezhuthachan, the Father of Malayalam literature.
draft.hungryLine: Tirur trades in seafood, so eat fish while you're here. Here are a few local favourites.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Visit Thunchan Parambu, 1.5 km away, where Ezhuthachan was born, then walk to Thrikkandiyur Mahadeva temple.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Thirunavaya on the banks of the River Nila and sit by the water.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The medieval Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics was centred mainly in and around today's Tirur Taluk.

seeFirst.caption: Short walks and drives from here

spots.name: Thrikkandiyur Mahadeva temple
spots.detail: 20 min walk · One of the 108 Shiva temples

spots.name: Thirunavaya Banks
spots.detail: 8 km southeast · Riverbank of the old Mamankam festival

legends.title: The Mamankam warriors
legends.body: This riverbank was home to Mamankam, once the biggest Hindu festival of South India. Tales of Malabar soldiers and the Valluvanad suicide squad are still told here.

legends.title: An old Bhadrakaali shrine
legends.body: Vairankode is one of the oldest Bhadrakaali temples in Kerala. Its yearly Vairankode Vela is one of the most loved festivals in the area.

tips.title: Come in early Feb.
tips.body: The Thunchan Utsavam literary festival is held at Thunchan Parambu in the first week of February.

tips.title: Arrive by train.
tips.body: Tirur sits on the Shoranur to Mangalore rail line, about 52 km south of Kozhikode.

story.title: Stargazers and mathematicians
story.body: The Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics was centred mainly in and around Tirur Taluk.

story.title: The Tanur principality
story.body: Puthiyangadi in Tirur was the headquarters of the Tanur principality, which often allied with the Zamorins of Calicut.

story.title: Mamankam ends
story.body: The great Mamankam festival at Thirunavaya died out in the 18th century after the British annexed Malabar.

story.title: Kerala's first station
story.body: Tirur railway station was built, and it is the oldest railway station in Kerala.

story.title: Fish, betel and gadgets
story.body: Tirur is a major trading centre for seafood, betel and electronic devices in northern Kerala.

food.name: Thazhe Palam Vegetarian Restaurant
food.detail: Vegetarian meals at Thazhe Palam, about 1 km away

food.name: Khaja Cafe
food.detail: Kuttan beef biriyani, at Kattachira about 5 km away
